verdict.rationale: Mangopay provides fraud-rule customization, dispute/chargeback handling, webhooks for event notifications, and a profiler for bot/VPN detection, which together give some risk-signal building blocks for ops teams. However there's no evidence of a consolidated per-sub-merchant risk dashboard, anomaly alerts across a seller portfolio, or explicit tools to pause payouts or offboard bad actors. missing for 10: portfolio-wide risk dashboard, anomaly detection/alerts per seller, payout-pause/offboarding workflow, independent corroboration of these risk-ops features in practice.
